steps: 1. Run `/et_modifier_audit` in the Keep before spawning anything, and keep its chat summary.
2. Play a lord-bearing mission and encounter, in the same session, at least one Special, one Elite, one Boss and the Lord.
3. Cross one transition, then encounter one more enemy of a category already sampled.
assertions: bounded `[et:453]` rows carry the classification evidence - at most two live rows per category across Special, Elite, Boss and Lord - each naming the category, breed, eligibility, the rejection counts, and the exact skip reason; the two audit summaries agree on the modifier count and gap count; the audit applies no modifier, mutates no enemy and stacks no callback, and the enemies behave exactly as vanilla throughout. `/et_regression_test` reports no new failures. A category with zero rows means it was never encountered in this session, not that classification failed - say which categories were actually seen.
Script one spawn per category including a lord; run /et_modifier_audit; assert rows for all four categories and the gap list; then build per category.
